items.title: AI 학습에 내 책이 쓰인다면? 출판계 저작권 보호·지원 법안 본격 시동
items.excerpt: 윤용근 의원 등 14인이 발의한 '출판문화산업 진흥법' 개정안이 11월 16~25일 입법예고되는 가운데, 출판물의 AI 학습 이용과 권리자 동의·보호 체계가 쟁점으로 떠올랐다. (셀렉트스타·출협 협약 부분은 기보도.)
items.rationale: A concrete new bill now in its public-comment window (Nov 16-25) that would set consent and protection rules for using Korean publications in AI training. Rights holders can still weigh in.

items.title: More AI Prompts Found in Journal Papers
items.excerpt: Blatant LLM instructions such as 'write a positive review' left in published papers are the starkest sign yet that authors are trying to game AI-assisted peer review, scholars warn.
items.rationale: New evidence of prompt injection aimed at AI-assisted peer review, found in published papers. Editors and scholarly publishers can screen for it now.

items.title: 'Ahead of his time': AI helps unlock discoveries hidden in notebooks of man who transformed maths
items.excerpt: Kurt Gödel left 1,009 pages of shorthand notebooks; AI-assisted transcription is now helping scholars decode them and surface overlooked ideas — an archival/manuscript use of AI.
items.rationale: A credible, concrete case of AI transcribing a shorthand manuscript archive. It shows a reusable workflow for editors working with archives and unpublished papers.

items.title: 잉크플록, 한국 웹소설 해외 유통을 위한 AI 현지화 체계 개발
items.excerpt: 스타트업 잉크플록이 한국 웹소설을 해외에 유통하기 위한 AI 기반 번역·현지화 체계를 개발했다.
items.rationale: A new product: an AI translation and localization pipeline for exporting Korean web novels. It adds a tool to a day that is otherwise about policy and integrity.

items.title: Can this golden audio era deliver on its potential?
items.excerpt: Ahead of the British Audio Awards, audiobook executives (Bonnier, Libro.fm and others) discuss how AI is reshaping production workflows and driving 'audio content inflation' as production costs fall, alongside discoverability and pricing pressure.
items.rationale: On-whitelist trade piece with named executives on how AI-cheapened audiobook production is causing 'content inflation'. This is a different angle from the earlier audiobook cards about consumer polls and narrators.
